notes: Chart of accounts: one account per document page (no lines) so that the balance panel and the 'add sub-account' button of the legacy tree can be shown. Level / parent / structure checks, parent becomes a main account, grants to company and group, delete rules (APP_RULES3_GL, see processes/ACMAST.md)

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or ACCOUNT_NUMBER in (select m2.account_number from ac_master m2, ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0')))
